command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop('expected three RDS inputs')
names(args) <- c('97', '98', '99')

lfc_threshold <- 1.5
padj_threshold <- 0.05
organism <- 'pau'

read_result <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  df$gene_id <- rownames(df)
  if (!'log2FoldChange' %in% names(df)) stop('missing log2FoldChange column')
  df
}

res <- lapply(args, read_result)
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(res, function(d) d$gene_id))

link_url <- sprintf('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/%s', organism)
pathway_url <- sprintf('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/%s', organism)
links <- read.delim(link_url, header = FALSE, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c('gene', 'pathway'))
links$gene_id <- sub('^[^:]+:', '', links$gene)
links$pathway_id <- sub('^path:', '', links$pathway)
links <- unique(links[, c('gene_id', 'pathway_id')])

pnames <- read.delim(pathway_url, header = FALSE, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c('pathway', 'pathway_name'))
pnames$pathway_id <- sub('^path:', '', pnames$pathway)
pnames <- pnames[, c('pathway_id', 'pathway_name')]

universe <- sort(intersect(common_genes, unique(links$gene_id)))
if (length(universe) == 0) stop('empty mapped universe')
links_u <- links[links$gene_id %in% universe, , drop = FALSE]
pathway_genes <- split(links_u$gene_id, links_u$pathway_id)
pathway_genes <- lapply(pathway_genes, unique)
pathway_ids <- names(pathway_genes)

ora_one <- function(foreground, strain, direction) {
  foreground <- sort(intersect(unique(foreground), universe))
  N <- length(universe)
  K <- length(foreground)
  rows <- lapply(pathway_ids, function(pid) {
    genes <- pathway_genes[[pid]]
    n <- length(genes)
    hits <- intersect(foreground, genes)
    q <- length(hits)
    p <- if (K == 0 || q == 0) 1 else phyper(q - 1, n, N - n, K, lower.tail = FALSE)
    data.frame(strain = strain, direction = direction, pathway_id = pid,
               universe_size = N, foreground_size = K, pathway_size = n,
               overlap = q, pvalue = p, genes = paste(hits, collapse = ','),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out$padj <- p.adjust(out$pvalue, method = 'BH')
  out <- merge(out, pnames, by = 'pathway_id', all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  out[order(out$padj, out$pvalue, out$pathway_id), c('strain','direction','pathway_id','pathway_name','universe_size','foreground_size','pathway_size','overlap','pvalue','padj','genes')]
}

all_ora <- list()
for (strain in names(res)) {
  df <- res[[strain]]
  df <- df[df$gene_id %in% universe & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange), , drop = FALSE]
  all_ora[[paste(strain, 'up', sep = '_')]] <- ora_one(df$gene_id[df$log2FoldChange > lfc_threshold], strain, 'up')
  all_ora[[paste(strain, 'down', sep = '_')]] <- ora_one(df$gene_id[df$log2FoldChange < -lfc_threshold], strain, 'down')
}
ora <- do.call(rbind, all_ora)
write.table(ora, file = 'ora_results.tsv', sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

sig_sets <- list()
for (direction in c('up','down')) {
  sig_sets[[direction]] <- lapply(names(res), function(strain) {
    unique(ora$pathway_id[ora$strain == strain & ora$direction == direction & ora$padj < padj_threshold])
  })
  names(sig_sets[[direction]]) <- names(res)
}
common_up <- Reduce(intersect, sig_sets[['up']])
common_down <- Reduce(intersect, sig_sets[['down']])
common_same <- sort(unique(c(common_up, common_down)))
summary <- data.frame(metric = c('organism','lfc_threshold','padj_threshold','universe_size','common_up_count','common_down_count','unique_same_direction_count','common_up_ids','common_down_ids'),
                      value = c(organism, lfc_threshold, padj_threshold, length(universe), length(common_up), length(common_down), length(common_same), paste(sort(common_up), collapse = ','), paste(sort(common_down), collapse = ',')),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.table(summary, file = 'summary.tsv', sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(length(common_same)), 'final_count.txt')
